about: Golden title-level queries for e2e/semantic.e2e.js. `expect` names bookmarks by their URL path on the fixture site; the query's rank is the best rank of any of them. A `must` query fails the test unless one is in the top 3; every ranked query counts toward the mean reciprocal rank. `folder` and `limit` are passed to semantic_search. A query with `max_results` and no `expect` is unrelated to the library: it passes if at most that many bookmarks clear the cutoff.
